questions.question: Identify the error: "The group of students are studying hard."

points.text: "are" should be "is" - the subject is "group" (singular), not "students"

questions.question: Rewrite using active voice: "The window was broken by the ball."
What type of sentence is this? "When the rain stopped, the children ran outside."

points.text: Complex sentence - main clause ("the children ran outside") + subordinate clause ("when the rain stopped")

questions.question: Correct the tense inconsistency: "She walks into the room and saw the mess."

points.text: She walked into the room and saw the mess. (or: She walks into the room and sees the mess.)

questions.question: Complete: "Neither the teacher nor the students ___ (is/are) responsible."

points.text: are - with "neither...nor", the verb agrees with the nearest subject ("students")
